FU-008.reason: WordNewBookReaderPlayback: after resolveAudioUrl a paused engine sets src and handlers (clipArmed) but skips play(). A step reached while paused with nothing to play is parked, and resume() re-runs it. resume() plays the element only when it holds the current step's clip, so audio no longer starts under a paused UI and the next press toggles correctly. Every onended path goes through runStep, which parks while paused.

FU-009.reason: useOrchAudioPlayback: jumpSeqRef is bumped by every playback command, by the mode switch and by the engine cleanup. A segment jump applies only if its sequence and engine instance are still current, so a late ensureRange no longer plays a stale segment or plays after leaving the page.

FU-023.reason: WfNewBookReader.loadVerses: newest load wins; stale loads return [] without touching verses or loadingVerses. The book effect invalidates in-flight loads, loads progress once and checks cancelled after awaiting it. WfNewApp keys the reader by sourceKey, so a book change remounts it.
